Read by ios/Sources/MorseKitCheck/main.swift and

Every expected value below was worked out by hand (or by the formula in
'derivation', on paper and in a scratch script) from the rules, not
captured from either port. Do not regenerate it to make a failing test
pass; change it only when the rule is meant to change.

rules: Asteroids drift straight in from the rim of the field toward the ship at
the centre. 'progress' runs 0 at the rim to 1 at the ship and takes
'approachTime' seconds; an asteroid at progress 1 has struck the ship,
costs a life, counts a miss and breaks the combo.
spawnInterval(wave, d) = max(minSpawnInterval, baseSpawnInterval * spawnTightening^(wave-1)) * timeScale(d)
approachTime(wave, d)  = max(minApproachTime, baseApproachTime * approachTightening^(wave-1)) * timeScale(d)
A spawn is skipped while 'maxOnField' asteroids are on the field.
Spawn angles are the centres of 'sectors' equal sectors; consecutive
spawns never share a sector.
A hit scores pointsPerCharacter * (label length) * multiplier(combo),
multiplier(combo) = min(4, 1 + (combo - 1) / 3)  (integer division).
Every 'hitsPerWave' hits clears a wave (fragments count).
A label of two or more characters splits when hit: one fragment per
character, in label order, each carrying the parent's progress and the
angle parent.angle + (k - (n-1)/2) * splitSpread for k in 0..<n, with the
current wave's approach time.
Send mode keeps a buffer of the characters sent since it was last
resolved. Each character appends; a label equal to the buffer is a hit
(the nearest such asteroid: highest progress, then lowest id); a label
starting with the buffer keeps it as a partial; otherwise it is a miss,
and the character that should have come next is read off the nearest
asteroid whose label starts with the buffer minus its last character.
A hit or miss clears the buffer; so does 'sendBufferTimeout' seconds of
game time with nothing sent, silently.
Copy mode arms one asteroid at a time (chosen at random) and the game
sends its label; tapping any asteroid carrying that label is a hit,
tapping another is a miss confused with the tapped label's first
character, tapping nothing is ignored. When the armed asteroid is gone
the next is armed at once.
Word labels arrive from 'wordWaveStart': a spawn is a word with
probability wordChance(wave) = min(maxWordChance, wordChancePerWave * (wave - wordWaveStart + 1)),
zero before it. The word pool is the first 'wordRank' of the supplied
list, upper-cased, 'minWordLength'..'maxWordLength' characters long and
spelt entirely from the character set, without repeats.
Speed ramp (copy mode): a game opens 'startOffset' WPM under the
learner's character speed, never under 'minWpm':
startWpm = max(minWpm, characterWpm - startOffset), targetWpm = max(minWpm, characterWpm).
Every 'hitsPerStep' hits in total it steps up 'step' WPM, capped at the
target; a strike on the ship steps it down 'step', never under the start;
a miss leaves it alone. Farnsworth is ignored.

Send mode, character set K only, no words, hitsPerWave 8, Normal, wave
1 throughout (approach 12 s). 'place' puts an asteroid on the field
directly (AsteroidsGame.place); 'send' feeds one decoded character;
'advance' moves time. 'buffer' is the send buffer after the event.
Points: CQ = 100 x 2 x m(1) = 200; the fragments C and Q at combo 1 and
2 are 100 each; K at combo 1 is 100; CALL = 100 x 4 x m(2) = 400.
The Z after CQ split: the buffer was empty, so every asteroid is a
candidate; the two fragments tie on progress and the lower id (C, made
first) is nearest, so C was expected. X after 'CA': only CALL starts
with 'CA', so its third character L was expected. The K sent while a
K asteroid and the CALL are both up is an exact match, so it is a hit at
once rather than a partial. After CALL splits, its C fragment is on the
field, so the last label placed is KM: the K is a partial, and 2.6 s of
silence with it pending clears the buffer without a miss, and does not
spawn (2.6 < 3.0, and the field is full anyway).
Copy mode, character set K only, no words, characterWpm 30: start 22,
target 30; lives raised so strikes do not end the game. A test drives it
with AsteroidsGame.place: 'hit' places a K if nothing is armed, then
taps the armed asteroid; 'wrongTap' places an M and taps it; 'strike'
places a K at progress 0.99 and advances 0.05 s at a time until it
